entries.note: Goods being prepared: the shipper has booked the waybill at its branch before the parcel is collected.
Collected and loaded at the sending branch.
Taken in at the delivering branch.
Left the branch for its delivery round. The next scan, 배송중, is the driver on the way.
Delivered. The tracking page words it 물품을 배송완료 하였습니다.
The tracking page's script words it 고객님의 물품을 전달 받았습니다: the parcel was handed over.
Loaded for the line haul; the script words it 물품을 배송지로 보내기 위해 발송하였습니다.
Left a terminal; the script words it 물품을 배송하기위해 이동중입니다.
Taken in at a terminal; the script words it 물품을 배송하기위해 이동중입니다.
Unloaded from the line haul at the delivering end. The script words it 물품이 배송지에 도착하였습니다, arrived at the delivery area, which is not a delivery.
Left for delivery; the script words it 물품을 배송하기위해 출발하였습니다.
